reviews.title: Recommended
reviews.text: This app is very helpful and insightful, and can provide a sense of clarity to carry on with your day.
reviews.reply:
Dear User, hello there!
Thank you so much for your feedback, you put a big smile on our faces! Our team is hard at work trying to continuously improve our app and it’s always rewarding to hear kind words. We love that you love us!
Best wishes, Nebula team

reviews.title: Be careful with your information
reviews.text: I downloaded this app and signed in with the info of date of birth etc, however what this app does not tell you from the beginning is that is also collecting automatically your device language settings, IP address, time zone, operating system, mobile carrier, hardware ID, Facebook ID & other unique identifiers. I am not comfortable with this data collection and they are not upfront with this info before you enter your details. Also you cannot see their reviews to know what other ppl have to say. If you see this before you download be careful
reviews.reply: Hello, all [Name] that you give us is stored in your phone. We do not use it for any purposes different from those described in the terms of use. Regards, Nebula Team
